import copy, json
from pathlib import Path
from work import evaluate

requests = json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())
policy = json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())
report = json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())
assert report == [evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]

# Independent boundary probes: one relevant complete-state change among duplicates,
# missing-state equivalence, ignored and undeclared noise, canonical key ordering,
# and immutability.
probes = [
    ({'declared':['b','a','b','gone'], 'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'same'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'noise':{'v':1}}, 'current':{'a':{'hash':'same','kind':'file'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'gone':{'kind':'missing'},'noise':{'v':2}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['b']}),
    ({'declared':['skip','x'], 'saved':{'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}, 'current':{'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'9'},'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}}}, {'ignored':['skip']}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),
    ({'declared':['added','removed'], 'saved':{'removed':{'kind':'file','hash':'r'}}, 'current':{'added':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}}}, {}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['added','removed']}),
]
for request, probe_policy, expected in probes:
    before = copy.deepcopy((request, probe_policy))
    assert evaluate(request, probe_policy) == expected
    assert (request, probe_policy) == before
print(json.dumps({'report_ok': True, 'independent_probes_passed': len(probes)}))
